notes.title: 5.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Device Pairing[/h2]
You Are Now Able To Pair SteamVR Devices With OVRAS.

SteamVR Tab -> Device Pairing Information

In General, with an empty dongle, make your device enter pairing mode (blue-flashing light), and hit pair in app. The Dongle Must not have another device currently attached to it and powered.

[b]Why?[/b] Unlike Steam's Native interface ours allows you to bind to specific dongles. Additionally for users that use additional devices besides the controllers it is a very common for your controllers to  get bound to dongles that are not the Headsets, in this configuration you can have tracking issues, and strongly suggest you bind your controllers to the HMD.

[h2]Space Drag Multiplier[/h2]
Multiplier in Space Drag to allow you to multiply your real world movement i.e. drag 1m translates to 2m in game with a 2x multiplier

[h2]Auto-Apply Chaperone[/h2]
Option in Settings you can now have a chaperone profile auto-apply on launch (great for WMR native chaperone users) At this time you will still have to close out of room-setup so not quite 100% yet.

[h1]Settings Removal[/h1]
The Following Settings Have Been Removed to better support Space Drag Features (i.e. these are all defaulted on now)

[list]
[*]Enable Seated Motion
[*]Enable Un-Cal Motion
[*]OpenXR Fix
[/list]

The Following Setting has been removed because a change to OpenVR/SteamVR Deprecated it

[list]
[*] Adjust Chaperone
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed battery indicator for Tundra Trackers
[*]Fixed an Issue causing some long identifiers to make device pairing information text overlap
[*]Added another digit of precision to fling multiplier to be more in line with the rest of the page
[/list]

notes.title: 5.4.0 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]New Things[/h1]

[h3]Device Pairing Information[/h3]
[list]
[*] In SteamVR tab There is now a "Device Information" tab
[*] this tab Displays the Amount of SteamVR dongles you have and in-use, as well as to what dongle the Controller/Tracker Is Bound to.
[*] We Currently Recognize 2 unique types of dongles headset and Tundra, all other dongles are seen as standard dongle These are tested to include HTC's and converted steam controller dongles.
[*] If you have other Types of Dongles, and would like to run some tests to see if we can uniquely identify those as well please reach out.
[/list]


[h3]Apply Offset Keybind[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Keybind to apply Offsets
[/list]

[h3]OpenXR patch[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added option in Settings to Enable better Support for OpenXR
[*] Note: This is a work-around forcing the tracking universe to be "standing" on our end, it will change in the Future
[/list]

[h3]Uncalibrated Motion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added option in Settings to Allow motion while in uncalibrated playspace
[*] Note: This is for the hybrid tracking/non-steamVR Users that have issues using Space Drag, Enabling should allow these users to use it without issue.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Force changed Default state of Chaperone Auto-Recovery to Off, and Inverted display in Settings Menu.
[/list]

notes.title: 5.1.1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:

[*]Fixed an issue with Legacy Center Marker Buttons[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug with premade key combos that required holding one key did not work correctly[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Linux Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a linux bug with custom keybind input[/*]
[*]Fixed a segfault issue with Manjaro - may still be some scaling issues with Manjaro.[/*]
[/list]

[list]
[*]Clarified Naming of Various Rotation Methods in app[/*]
[*]Clarified Instructions regarding OpenGL GPU in readme[/*]
[*]Added a Scroll bar to Settings page, will need to be flushed out and cleaned up, but there are a few configs where you might need it currently.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: 5.0.1 Released (Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
[h2]5.0.1[/h2]

Mostly Minor Fixes, fixed some bugs w/ Redirected walking, encouraged to try it again if you don't think it was behaving accurately.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue w/ default state of brightness overlay Being too dark [/*]
[*]Set minimum brightness of brightness overlay so you should still be able to see even at lowest [/*]
[*]Adds a shutdown button for OVRAS to settings tab (just closes OVRAS) [/*]
[*]Altered Default Value of De-tangle Angle to be more aggressive [/*]
[*]Adjusted Slider behavior for auto-turn speed now maxes out at 900, and increments by 10 deg[/*]
[*]Adjusted Name of Auto-turn to add more clarity (may change in future) [/*]
[*]Fixed a redirected walking bug caused by copy/paste error [/*]
[*]Fixed a redirected walking error where interframe arc-length was calculated wrong, leading to under-estimation [/*]
[*]Fixed an issue where seated re-center button would be hidden [/*]
[/list]
